metadata.name: Elwha River Delta Measurements
metadata.description: Dataset containing measurements from the Elwha River Delta, including latitude, longitude, elevation, horizontal and vertical root mean square errors, status, description, and event information. The data was collected over a short period on February 3, 2012, with consistent spatial coverage and periodic temporal sampling.
metadata.spatial: Point locations with a tight cluster around the Elwha River Delta
metadata.temporal: Sub-second resolution with measurements taken over approximately 26 minutes
